name: veribl
description: Veribl is the digital product passport and post-purchase platform for product brands: EU digital product passports, product pages behind the QR code, a Help Center, a helpdesk, product registration, warranty claims and spare parts. This plugin lets ChatGPT work on all of it with the brand.

interface.longDescription:
Veribl is the digital product passport and post-purchase platform for product brands. Every product gets a page behind the QR code, with its EU digital product passport, and around it Veribl runs the brand's Help Center, helpdesk, product registration, warranty plans and claims, and spare parts.

With the Veribl plugin, ChatGPT works on all of it with you:
- Digital product passports: see what each EU rule still needs (ESPR, batteries, textiles), fill passport, battery, substance and environmental data from your documents, manage units, serial numbers and batches, review supplier answers and check EU registry status.
- Product pages: turn a product manual (PDF) into help articles with steps, tables and the manual's own diagrams, translate them into your languages and add spare parts and accessories.
- Help Center: write and update brand-wide articles (shipping, returns, warranty terms, troubleshooting) and organize them into categories.
- Helpdesk: find tickets, read the conversation, summarize the case and draft a reply for you to approve.
- Registration and warranty: look up product registrations and warranty plans, review warranty claims with their photos and proof of purchase, and draft replies or decisions for you to approve.
- Design: style your product pages and Help Center to match your website, with a preview before anything goes live.

You stay in control. Articles are saved as drafts unless you ask to publish them, theme changes stay unpublished until you say so, and replies to customers or claim decisions only happen when you approve them. ChatGPT never publishes a passport: that stays your decision in Veribl. Every call is logged in Veribl under Developers › Logs, and you can revoke access any time in Settings › API keys.
capabilities: Check digital product passport readiness per EU rule
Fill passport, battery and substance data from documents
Manage units, serial numbers and batches
Turn product manuals into help articles
Translate articles into the brand's languages
Write and organize Help Center articles
Look up product registrations and warranty plans
Draft replies to customers for approval
Style product pages and the Help Center
defaultPrompt: What's still missing from my product passports?
Turn this manual into help articles for my product
Which warranty claims and tickets need a reply?

positive.prompt: Which products do I have in Veribl?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brand's products with name, model, status and product page link.

positive.prompt: Here's the manual for the AirCrisp Duo 9L. Turn it into help articles as drafts.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates draft articles grouped into categories, each citing the manual pages it comes from, and ends with a summary and the product page link.

positive.prompt: Translate the AirCrisp Duo 9L articles into German.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a German version of each article with the same structure and unchanged numbers.

positive.prompt: What's still missing from the AirCrisp Duo 9L passport?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open passport items per rule and how to fill each one.

positive.prompt: Which warranty claims are waiting for a reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open claims waiting for a reply with product, customer issue and age; no message is sent.

negative.prompt: Publish the passport for the AirCrisp Duo 9L.
Fill in the recycled content for the AirCrisp Duo 9L, just guess.
Reply to all open claims that we're looking into it.

review.commerce_description: Veribl does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: product pages from manuals, Help Center articles, helpdesk tickets, product registrations, warranty plans and claims, spare parts, digital product passports (readiness, passport/battery/substance data, units, batches, supplier answers, registry) and theme design.
